description: This file contains Redux action creators for channel view management in Mattermost, including switching, joining, leaving channels, handling posts, and UI updates.

methods.name: goToLastViewedChannel
methods.description: Navigates to the last viewed channel or redirects if already in that channel.

methods.name: switchToChannelById
methods.description: Switches to a channel given its ID, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: loadIfNecessaryAndSwitchToChannelById
methods.description: Loads channel data if not already loaded, then switches to it.

methods.name: switchToChannel
methods.description: Performs the logic to switch the current view to the specified channel, handling different channel types and navigation.

methods.name: joinChannelById
methods.description: Joins a channel by its ID.

methods.name: leaveChannel
methods.description: Leaves a channel, updating local storage and UI state accordingly.

methods.name: leaveDirectChannel
methods.description: Removes a direct message channel from local storage.

methods.name: autocompleteUsersInChannel
methods.description: Fetches user autocomplete suggestions within a channel.

methods.name: loadUnreads
methods.description: Loads unread posts for a channel, optionally prefetching.

methods.name: loadPostsAround
methods.description: Loads posts around a specific post ID in a channel.

methods.name: loadLatestPosts
methods.description: Loads the latest posts in a channel.

methods.name: loadPosts
methods.description: Loads posts in a channel with pagination, either before or after a post ID.

methods.name: syncPostsInChannel
methods.description: Synchronizes posts in a channel since a given timestamp.

methods.name: prefetchChannelPosts
methods.description: Preloads posts for a channel, either from recent or by syncing.

methods.name: scrollPostListToBottom
methods.description: Emits an event to scroll the post list UI to the bottom.

methods.name: markAsReadOnFocus
methods.description: Marks the current channel and thread as read when focused.

methods.name: updateToastStatus
methods.description: Updates the UI toast notification status.

methods.name: deleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a channel and updates UI state, stopping notification sounds.
